task.title: Validate discovered extension entrypoint targets
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/600 by proving that discovered entrypoints are extension-local regular files without reading or activating them.
acceptance_criteria: Traverse each entrypoint relative to the already-open extension-directory descriptor on Unix.
Reject symlinks at every component, require intermediate directories, and require a regular final file.
Return a typed target error containing the manifest path, authored entrypoint, and I/O source.
Leave standalone manifest loading lexical and keep target content, activation, and permissions out of scope.

attempts.summary: Established RED for discovered package target validation.
attempts.diagnostic: Lexically valid manifests could discover missing, symlinked, or directory entrypoints because discovery did not inspect the declared target.
attempts.patch: Added Unix tests for nested regular files, unreadable-but-inspectable files, missing targets, final and intermediate symlinks, and non-regular targets.

attempts.diagnostic: Opening intermediate components relative to the retained package descriptor and statting the final component without following links prevents path escape during discovery.
attempts.patch: Added validate_entrypoint_target, component-relative opens, regular-file checks, typed source-preserving errors, docs, and README milestone evidence.

attempts.summary: Verified and merged the non-activating filesystem boundary.
attempts.diagnostic: Focused adversarial tests, pinned verification, exact-head CI, substantive review, and unresolved-thread checks completed successfully.
attempts.patch: Pull request 601 squash-merged as d5a6a21c4de0b3701d1fb2d849f695f3cd868ad0 and closed issue 600.

outcome.summary: Unix discovery now fails closed unless every declared entrypoint is an extension-local non-symlink regular file, without reading target content or granting activation authority.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30174799508 and substantive CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/601

lessons: Lexical path checks and descriptor-anchored filesystem checks solve different parts of containment.
Symlink rejection must cover intermediate components as well as the final target.
File-type inspection does not require reading or executing target content.
Discovery-time validation is still not an activation lease; a future loader must reopen and revalidate safely.
